recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless the work group later chooses to define a computable invariant for these text-only rules.
issue_request: FHIR-44898 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 Vocabulary issue asking to clarify that ValueSet.compose.include.system and ValueSet.compose.exclude.system cannot reference CodeSystem supplements, and that required supplements must be declared through valueset-supplement or useSupplement.
initial_application: Commit 09caaf636406cf39544c443f4b55bbf33e78cfdf applied the issue by adding the three requested ValueSet composition rules to source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml.
additional_context: The clarification depends on the FHIR-13730 supplement infrastructure. The valueset-supplement extension is now in the FHIR Extension Pack, and FHIR-37529 added useSupplement operation parameters. Jira comments indicate the approved resolution was text guidance rather than a computable invariant.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml already contains the requested SHALL NOT rules and supplement declaration guidance verbatim, and ValueSet is active in the current build.
